## Overview

LRP-CA-010 is the letter-sound → word-reading review's headline, promoted from a scratch
fit to a registered model (#421 Tier 1). At each timepoint (t1–t4) it fits a between-child
Beta-Binomial regression of word-reading level on the standardised same-wave logit of
**letter-sound knowledge** (`L`), adjusting **only** for age, hearing (`hs`) and non-verbal
ability (block design, `blocks`) — *"at wave t, among children alike on age, hearing and
non-verbal ability, how much higher is word reading per +1 SD of letter sounds"*.

This is a deliberately **minimal** adjustment. The nearest registered model,
[`lrp-rli-ca-001`](../lrp-rli-ca-001), mutually adjusts word reading for five other
same-wave skills (`B`, `TR`, `TE`, `R`, `E`) — a different conditional question.
`ca-010` isolates the `L` → `W` level association against the trait covariates alone.
Its companion [`lrp-rli-ca-011`](../lrp-rli-ca-011) adds same-wave nonword decoding to
ask whether the association survives holding decoding fixed.

_Estimand: descriptive association (no causal warrant)._ Every coefficient is an
**adjusted association**, latent-general-ability-confounded — the only randomisation-licensed
effect in the study is the ITT arm. Read with the measurement-error and
collinearity/regularisation caveats in the Results section.

## Design

- **Four separate cross-sectional fits** (one row per child per wave), reported side by
  side — not one stacked model (issue #312 estimand decision). The largest-complete-outcome
  wave (ties → latest) is the diagnostic anchor, not substantively primary.
- **Letter sounds** enters as a standardised same-wave logit with a regularising
  `Normal(0, 0.3)` slope; age, hearing and non-verbal ability are the only adjusters.
- **Group** is a non-interpretable nuisance (absorbs arm composition), not reported.
- **Missing hearing status** uses the study's reference-fill plus `hs_missing` nuisance-offset policy; the flag is fitted only when it varies on that wave's outcome-complete rows. It is not a skill effect. Rows missing the focal outcome are dropped.
